title: vektor /// no. 058 — Rules that load only when they apply.
description: Somewhere in your CLAUDE.md is a procedure Claude reads at every startup and only needs on one kind of day. CLAUDE.md loads in full every session; a skill loads only its name and description until a request matches (code.claude.com docs, read 2026-09-29). I moved 24 lines of ship-day checks into one SKILL.md (measured with wc, 2026-09-29): the skill file, a blank template and the one-page sorting rule for what moves and what stays.
